scenarios.label: Maengseon screen
scenarios.coverage: Base support slots resolve to Maengseon screen and rescue roles.

scenarios.label: Panokseon artillery
scenarios.coverage: Fleet signal progression unlocks a Panokseon artillery lead in the second support slot.

scenarios.label: Disabled Geobukseon fallback
scenarios.coverage: The disabled Geobukseon support upgrade falls back to Maengseon screen slots while the player Geobukseon hull gate is tested separately.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Broad project smoke for load, wiring, HUD, support, upgrade, recovery, and runtime contracts.

scenarios.label: Load and scan
scenarios.coverage: Scripts and scenes load while legacy Godot 3 patterns stay out of the runtime surface.

scenarios.label: Runtime wiring
scenarios.coverage: Player, enemy, boss, support, launcher, projectile, HUD, recovery, and scene wiring contracts smoke together.

scenarios.label: Upgrade progression
scenarios.coverage: Upgrade data, player Geobukseon hull split, disabled Geobukseon support fallback, and level progression contracts remain coherent.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Focused boarding, ship damage, support rescue, and soldier incapacitation regressions with scene-load leak budgets.

scenarios.label: Impact and damage
scenarios.coverage: Boarding impact gating and ship damage contracts run through the generic scene load probe.

scenarios.label: Navigation and chaos
scenarios.coverage: Approach geometry, cleanup handling, and chaotic boarding state transitions keep their success markers.

scenarios.label: Support and recall
scenarios.coverage: Support boarding rescue, auto-raid recall, and soldier incapacitation behavior stay covered with bounded shutdown resource growth.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Short ship combat balance sweep for gunner, melee, firepot, mixed, large-ship boarding, and cleanup encounters.

scenarios.label: Role pressure
scenarios.coverage: Gunner duel, melee rush, firepot pressure, and mixed pressure scenarios print hull, crew, boarding, and event summaries.

scenarios.label: Atakebune boarding
scenarios.coverage: Large-ship boarding runs with boss guns disabled and close approach so deck-fight behavior can be checked directly.

scenarios.label: Cleanup encounters
scenarios.coverage: Head-on cleanup and cleanup drift scenarios report latch, boarder, defender, and raid-state debug lines.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Midgame support-fleet AI and runtime performance under Panokseon plus Maengseon escort load.

scenarios.label: Wing support roster
scenarios.coverage: The probe builds one player Panokseon, one support Panokseon, and four Maengseon supports in wing formation before measuring runtime samples.

scenarios.label: Long runtime samples
scenarios.coverage: The wrapper records FPS, frame-time percentiles, object counts, node counts, projectiles, and static memory across a configurable midgame duration.

scenarios.label: Pool reparent
scenarios.coverage: Released pooled nodes move under the pool root and reacquire detached and visible.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Soldier cross-deck jump ownership and landing.

scenarios.label: Jump landing
scenarios.coverage: Soldier jump preserves its start position, moves under the target deck, follows target motion, and clears jumping state on landing.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Cannon reload slot reservation and crew power fallback.

scenarios.label: Broadside reservation
scenarios.coverage: Active cannon slots stay reserved correctly while shared reload crew power updates broadside allocation.

scenarios.label: Legacy fallback
scenarios.coverage: Legacy reload multipliers still apply when newer shared crew-power fields are absent.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Flag scene kind mapping and mast swap contract.

scenarios.label: Boss swallowtail
scenarios.coverage: Boss flag scenes resolve to the concrete swallowtail scene and preserve yard and streamer presentation through the public flag API.

scenarios.label: Mast scene swap
scenarios.coverage: Mast kind swaps replace the active flag scene and report the new shape through the mast contract API.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Semantic UI and world-text typography presets.

scenarios.label: Menu display title
scenarios.coverage: Main menu title and caption labels resolve through the semantic display and caption presets instead of scene-authored overrides.

scenarios.label: HUD and callout
scenarios.coverage: HUD timer labels, preview billboard labels, and soldier speech labels use the shared typography helpers for font weight, outline, and billboard presentation.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Gameplay screen-edge vignette and motion blur overlay.

scenarios.label: Stationary neutral
scenarios.coverage: The overlay initializes a base vignette without adding noticeable motion blur while the player ship is stationary.

scenarios.label: Rowing boost
scenarios.coverage: Rowing and high-speed motion increase the screen-edge blur strength, and the effect settles back down when movement ends.

runtime_harnesses.focus: Responsive modal and HUD-adjacent UI layout fit across compact, HD, and ultrawide viewports.

scenarios.label: Compact viewport
scenarios.coverage: Main menu, pause, options, upgrade, meta-upgrade, and ship-control panels stay inside a 960x540 viewport after density scaling.

scenarios.label: HD viewport
scenarios.coverage: The same UI shells preserve spacing and remain bounded across 1280x720, 1600x900, and 1920x1080 viewports.

scenarios.label: Ultrawide viewport
scenarios.coverage: The same UI shells preserve spacing and remain bounded inside a 2560x1080 ultrawide viewport without overflowing anchors.

scenarios.label: Helper registry
scenarios.coverage: Every helper has a registered owner, public-surface baseline, dependency baseline, and known exception metadata.
